## SerializeSvgOptions.fitToContent property

Replace the viewBox with the bounding box of the drawing plus `padding`<!-- -->, so the file shows the whole figure rather than whatever part was panned into view.

**Signature:**

```typescript
fitToContent?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

true
